description: The endpoint gives the ability to view an Electronic Signature.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: company_id (either company_id or project_id is required)

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: project_id (either project_id or company_id is required)

parameters.name: electronic_signature_id
parameters.description: ID of the Electronic Signature to view.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Specifies how much information to show for the electronic signature. The minimal view returns only electronic signature information currently available. Specifying anything else defaults to all inf...

object_id.description: ID of the object that the Electronic Signature was created for

object_type.description: Type of the object that the Electronic Signature was created for

status.description: the status of the electronic signature

title.description: title of the state of the electronic signature

message.description: a message giving information about the state of the electronic signature

actions.description: actions that can be performed for the electronic signature in its current state

name.description: the name of an action that can be performed on the ElectronicSignature

url.description: the URL corresponding to the action

display_name.description: the i18n label for the buttons in the Docusign banner

items.description: The names of the current ball in court users
